reason: A DSH web plugin that lets users select or drag files into conversations, archives them locally, and routes images to the official attachment flow when supported.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供文件选择与拖放上传，将文件归档到本地并把图片或路径添加到对话草稿中。
summaries.en: Adds file selection and drag-and-drop uploads to DSH web, archiving files locally and adding images or paths to the conversation draft.

capabilities: Reads files explicitly selected or dragged into the DSH web interface
Writes uploaded files to a configurable local attachment directory
Adds file paths or image attachments to the conversation draft
Uploads supported images through the host's official attachment mechanism
Provides local configuration endpoints for attachment settings
